posts.meta_description:
243K likes, 2,165 comments - brindasharma on October 1, 2026: "The Wedding Edit 👀
Part 2: US 🏔️💕 

Us and @josephradhik wanted to pull off a kick ass shoot before the wedding around manali, and the day we started talking about it I knew we had to do it at Rohtang considering the amount of times we’ve shot there and how well @shresthvg and I know every inch of that landscape 😮‍💨

20th morning, we woke up at 4am, called @nishachoudhary2994 to tie my saree, assembled my bridesmaids @notrishikasharma @kristaldhanaraj @whatprekdoes @rheakukreti hehe and left to create literal ART ✨ 

Watch my stories for the BTS 🤪 
WORTH IT!!! 

#liveandlettravel".

78K likes, 681 comments - brindasharma on September 26, 2026: "So… I AM MARRIED 🥰🥰🥰🥰 

I know I have upset a lot of my girls, but as I said, “shaadi se zada humein galat insaan se shaadi se daarna chahiye” 🤏🏼 
Learnt that the hard way 🤪

I got married on my timeline, I live on my own terms, I drive my dream car and I’m getting married to the man I chose for myself (my dream man btw hehe) ❤️

So girls… PROMISE ME 
Pehele independence, then shaadi 🥰

#liveandlettravel #reelsindia #reelsinstagram".
